batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: st AB de Villiers b DL Vettori

batting.name: OA Shah
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b Z Khan

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c OA Shah b Pankaj Singh

batting.name: M Kaif

balls.text: pitched outside off, Rahane comes forward and punches it over the bowler to long-off and the batsman go through for a single
slower and short outside off, Hodge pulls it over to wide of long-on for a single
yorker, Rahane digs it out to cover for a single
thats the first ton of IPL 2012! comes charging down and slaps a short delivery over to long-on, Kohli overruns and misses the catch, the balls runs into the boundary picking up puff of dust with it
slower one and quite slow i should say, Rahane waits and waits as he looks to nudge it but misses
comes down the track and smashes the slower one past the bowler for a four, Rahane is on 97 now
good length, hits Hodge's pads as he looks to turn it away on to the leg side
slow and outside off, leans into it and pushes it cover for a single

Caught at long-on, finally Shah departs but he has done enough damage! looks to hoick a slower delivery but doesnt get the timing right and off it goes straight down the throat of Vinay Kumar, almost went for a six
keeps low and the keeper misses that, piling agony for RCB
on the money, Shah digs it out and squeezes it over backward point to the fence
slower one that kept low, Shah looks to push ti to cover but misses
doosra, that has been cut to cover for a run, 17 runs off the over!
quicker one, stays back and drives to cover for a run
tossed up, Rahane picks it and hammers it over the bowler's head for another boundary, he's smoking it here!
Rahane walks down the track and plays an inside out shot over wide of long-off, flat bats it
on the off, Shah slams it past the the bowler to long-off
quicker one outside off, Shah makes room and gets a bottom edge and the ball races away to the fence behind the keeper
that's Shah's 50, slower one outside off, delicately pats it to point for a single
full toss outside off, stays in the crease and slaps it past the diving fielder at cover
it's raining sixes here! picks it and smacks it over the bowler's head, that has come off the meat of the bat, stupendous shot!
Shah has hammered that! picks the slower one and smokes it high over the deep midwicket for a homer, see-ya!
slower one, yorker length, Rahane squeezes it to point and go through for an easy single
slower one outside off, Rahane picks the length quickly and mauls it over midwicket for a mammoth one, 15 rows back into the crowd, Rahane is in the mood here!
floating length, that's been dismissed from his presence into the gap between midwicket and long-on, one bounce over the boundary, 21 runs off that Gayle over!
tossed up on the leg side, quite wide and easy call for the umpire
on the pads, flicked to backward square leg for an easy two
short and flat, that's been clobbered high over midwicket into the second tier, that was a crowd killer!
takes it on the full and hoicks it to deep midwicket for a single
slower one, Shah drills it to deep midwicket for an easy single
tossed up and that's smacked, he's greeted him with a six, clubs it over wide of long-on for a six, Humongous shot
makes room to swipe it across the line, misses and the ball rolls to short cover after it hits Shah's pads
on the money again, Rahane takes it on the full and whips it to deep midwicket
yorker on the middle, Rahane makes room and tries to punch it through cover but misses
outside off, goes back and pushes it to cover
pushes it through the air, Shah looks to pull it over midwicket but misses
full toss, Shah gets into the act this time and he smacks it high over the bowler's head, Shah doesnt want to be left behind
6 fours off that over, this time he waits till the ball gets to him and guides it to the third man boundary, what an over that turned out to be!
full toss, Rahane makes that 5 fours on the trot, cover drives it elegantly
slower ball, Rahane pulls it over midwicket and off it goes racing away to the boundary off one bounce, 4 in 4!
short, Rahane bends and scoops it high over behind the keeper and gets a boundary for that, top shot!
2 in 2, exact replica of the previous shot but slightly straighter this time, punches it past the bowler
Rahane shows the full face of the bat and slaps it past the bowler for a four, brilliant timing!
good length, Shah pushes it to cover but Rahane wanted one but sent back in the nick of time
Shah stays in his crease and tries to go over midwicket but takes a top edge and the ball loops into the air and off it goes sailing over fine leg fence
width offered, Shah stays in his crease and pulls it straight to the man at midwicket
outside off, Rahane waits and uses the pace of the ball as he runs it to third man for a single
slightly short, Rahane uses his feet as he skips down the track and tries to slap it over covers but misses completely
pitches on good length straight away, Rahane defends it back to the bowler
pushed through again, Rahane watches it as it spins into him and works it away to fine leg for an easy run
quicker one, stays in the crease and nudges it to the  right of Murali
Shah comes down the track but manages to push the quicker one to sweeper cover
outside off, turned away to short midwicket for a single
quicker one, pushes it back to the bowler
Rahane does it again! skips down the track and clobbers it well over long-on for a massive six
flighted delivery, Rahane runs it down the ground to long-on for an easy single
Shah charges down but gets a thick inside edge and the ball rolls down the ground to long-on
quicker one, turned away to long-on for an easy run
tossed up, Shah makes room and dabs it to backward square leg and takes an easy single
Stumped! flatter delivery, Vettori pushes it through as he sees Dravid coming down the track, misses it by a big margin and the rest is cleaned up by AB De Villers behind the stumps
full outside off, bends and slaps it to sweeper cover for just a single
tossed up, Rahane punches it down the ground to long-on for an easy single
Rahane plays it to point off his backfoot
spinning into the batsman, makes room and crunches it to sweeper for a single
tossed up, punches down to wide of long-off
quicker one, Rahane chops it back to the bowler
doosra, Dravid makes room and loops that into the air to sweeper cover
tossed up on the legs, Dravid whips it to backward square leg for a single
quicker one on to the pads, Rahane punches it to long-on for a single
yorker, Dravid makes room and drives it to sweeper cover
quicker one, slashes it but doesnt get past Gayle at backward point
spinning into Dravid, gets an inside edge on to the pads and the ball goes to the leg side
wide outside off, looks to sweep it over midwicket and misses by a huge margin
spinning away, watches it carefully and dabs it to wide of Gayle at slip
outside off, lets it come to him and slaps it to sweeper cover
tossed up, turned away to backward square leg for a single
tossed up, bends his knee and chips it straight to wide of long-on
goes back again and sweeps it to deep square and sneak a two
skidder, goes back and pushes it to short cover
tossed up, Dravid loops the ball into the air between extra cover and long-off and go through for a run
on the full, Dravid looks to drive it through covers but misses it
pushed through the air, turned away to midwicket for an easy single
on the full, Dravid slams it through covers to long-off
that's a ripper, Dravid gives room but the ball turns the other way
on good length, turns it away with soft hands to short midwicket for a run
width offered, Rahane stays in the crease and runs it to third man for an easy single
Dravid comes down the track, tries to pull it over midwicket, gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls on to the off side
pitched outside off, Rahane watches it cautiously and guides it to third man for a run
angling into the batsman, skips down the track and turns it away to mid-on and sneak a single
magnificent shot! Dravid puts his foot forward and drives it through covers for a four, Elegance written all over the shot
on the full, on the toes, turned away to backward square leg for an easy single
outside off, bunts it to the off side and the batsmen scurry for a single
short of a length, Rahane gives the charge and takes the top edge and the ball goes sailing over the deep square leg boundary
Dravid comes down the track and drives it to mid-off and gets to the other end, he'd be relieved!
make that 11, pitched on a good length, Dravid defends it back to the bowler
Dravid goes back in his crease and crams it to covers, no run again, 10 dots on the bounce for Zaheer
pitched on a good length, Dravid leans back and jams it to covers for a dot
good length, gets forward and defends it to cover for no run
off the back foot, this time he smacks it high over mid wicket for a one bounce boundary, not timed well but will still get a four
that has been savagely dealt with, gives the charge and carts it high over long-on for a six, into the crowd this time
Dravid goes back and tries to slap it past midwicket but gets an underedge and the ball goes to deep square leg
pitched on a good length, Dravid defends it to cover for a dot
short outside leg, Dravid goes deep into his crease and helps it on his way to the fine leg fence
back of a length, Rahane comes a bit forward and turns it to short midwicket, that was a maiden from Zaheer!
short of a length, looks to heave over midwicket but misses it and the keeper collects it cleanly
Rahane bunts it to Kohli at point and takes off but gets back to the crease on time
good length again, Rahane defends it solidly on to the off side
outside off, Rahane looks to cut it past point but the ball falls just short of Kohli at point
good length from Zaheer, Rahane bends and dabs it to the off side for no run
back of a length, Dravid stays in the crease and pushes it to mid-off
width offered, slices it to the left of Kohli at point who dives and saves 3 runs for his team
leaning over the ball, Rahane pierces the gap between backward point and square cover, superb placement
slightly short outside off, bouncing off the seam, Rahane chops it onto the pitch for no run
width offered and angling away, watches it carefully and lets it go to the keeper
wide outside off, Rahane smears it through the gap between backward point and point, top shot!
on the good length, Dravid comes forward but is cramped for room and defends it to the right of Zaheer for no run
good length and angling away, looks to poke it but lets it go to the keeper
keeps low again, Dravid shows the full face of the bat and blocks it back to the  bowler
Dravid gets a big inside edge and the ball goes to the fine leg boundary but Murali shows his football skills and stops it
low bounce off the pitch, looks to drive through the covers but misses, straight to the keeper
good length on the middle and off, Dravid stays in the crease and turns it away to short midwicket

It's all over! starts and finishes off with Rahane in action again, Murali gives room and tries to loft it over covers but it comes off the bottom of the bat and loops high and our man of the evening Rahane at cover runs back and takes a regulation catch
on the legs, whipped to deep backward square leg for a single
short of a length, Aravind swings across the line and misses, straight to the keeper
length outside off, Aravind goes down on one knee and hammers it over the bowler's head with a flat bat, one bounce over the ropes
Aravind pulls it over to mid-on wherein Shah is late to react as he goes for the catch but falls short of him and the ball bounces in front of him and rolls on to the fence
similar line and length, angling in slightly, Murali tries to heave it over deep midwicket but misses it again, typical Murali trying to slog
change of pace deceives Murali as he looks to swipe it across the line and misses by a good margin
wide outside off, that has been drilled to wide long-on and go through for an easy single
pulls it over midwicket and scamper for two but a wild shy at the stumps from the keeper allows the batsmen to scramble for an extra run
similar line, Murali connects it this time as he swivels it over midwicket for a two
that's a typical Murali shot! slower one, he looks to swing across and misses it
on the full this time, Aravind pushes it to short midwicket as Hogg runs across and fields it
looks to sweep it away but fails to make contact as it spins sharply away from Aravind
tossed up outside off, Murali looks to drive but squeezes it to backward point
floating on the leg stump, Murali comes on the front foot and shows the full face of the bat to Hogg
Caught at midwicket! floating length, Zaheer tries to go over midwicket with a fierce pull but hits it out straight to Rahane who takes an easy catch
wrong 'un, Zaheer does not pick it at all, goes to the keeper
length ball angling away, Aravind tries to slap it past cover but it takes a thick outside edge and races away to the third man boundary

Bowled! that's the sixth time the timber has been disturbed in this innings, slightly short, skips down the track and looks to heave it over midwicket but the ball nips back off the seam and knocks the top of his middle stump
slower one, Vinay steers it to fielder at point for no run
outside off again, pulled to deep midwicket again for a quick two
wide outside off, smeared to deep midwicket with brute force and gets a boundary, fielder there tries to stop it but in vain
jags back in from off, flicked to deep midwicket, fielder picks it and hits the stumps and the ball deflects, batsmen have enough time to get an extra run
floating length again, Zaheer tries to heave it over midwicket but misses and the ball thumps onto his pads , Vinay looks for a run but is denied, quite rightly so
tossed up, Vinay kumar skips down the track and slaps it to deep midwicket
Caught! Kaif tries to smash it out of the stadium but does not connect it well and it goes a mile high into sky and Hodge has enough time to settle under it and gobble that up at long-on
goes for a switch hit but miscues it and it falls short of long-on
nips into Vinay kumar as he looks to steer it past point
tossed on the full, charges down and crunches it to long-on for another run
good length, Kaif punches it straight past the bowler down the ground, that was a gem of an over from Trivedi, he picked up 2 wickets in that!
length outside off, smears it to sweeper cover for another single
Bowled! one more bites the dust! Trivedi follows Vettori as he makes room and looks to drive it through covers and takes a faint inside edge and goes on to peg his leg stump back
Kaif shuffles across as the ball is being bowled and flicks it to wide of long-on for a single
change of pace, Vettori prods it down the ground to long-off for a single
Bowled! slower one, Tiwary doesnt move his feet and swings across the line, tries to go over midwicket but misses, ball goes crashing into the middle stump
finally gets one over the ropes! yorker gone awry, comes out as full toss, Kaif clubs it over wide of long-on for a maximum, there was brute power behind that
yorker length, Tiwary squeezes it down along the turf to long-on, only a single
turning away, Kaif waits and cuts it to cover for another run
short and flat, Tiwary finds the fielder at deep midwicket, doesnt time it at all
flighted one, Kaif skips down the track and punches it down to long-on for another single
tossed up, charges down the track and looks to smack it over midwicket but gets an outside edge and flies to short third man on one bounce
slightly short, Tiwary pulls it off his backfoot  to wide of long-on for an easy single, singles are not going to do any good for RCB
slower one which keeps low, Kaif gently pushes it to the man at cover for a single
on the full, Tiwary flat bats it down the ground to long-off and a single is what they get
well bowled, on good length, Tiwary blocks it back to the bowler
short and hammered! Tiwary rocks back on his haunches and heaves it over deep midwicket for a six, they need more of those
pitched on good length, Kaif comes a tad forward and dabs it to cover for an easy single
floating length on the middle and leg, Kaif leans forward and loops that into the air over the bowler's head but it falls short of the man at long-off
tossed up, Tiwary takes it on the full and crunches it to long-off and results in another single
on the off, Kaif pats it to backward point for an easy single, they are still dealing in singles here
tossed up again, Kaif is all at sea with that delivery as it hits his pads
flighted again, drives it to mid-on again
tossed up, Kaif goes back and punches it to mid-on
keeps low on the pads, slower one, Tiwary tries to flick it to midwicket but the ball hits his pads and rolls onto the on side for no run
similar line, Kaif cuts it to sweeper cover and he gets off the mark with an easy single
slower one wide outside off shaping away, Kaif pokes at it and misses, straight to the keeper

Bowled! that's the final nail in the coffin for RCB, Kohli doesnt pick the slower one as he swipes across the line and looks to pull it over midwicket but the ball goes straight through the gate and his middle stump is knocked back
shortish on the middle and off, Tiwary tries to pull it over midwicket but doesnt time it well and it loops into the air and falls in the midwicket region
Slower one angling in, Kohli wristily flicks it down the ground to long-on for an easy single
skids through and rams his pads and there's a confident appeal or lbw! That was missing leg I reckon, big turn inwards
the googly, plays it late and he punches it down to deep point
big turn and he pushes it with the turn to cover
tossed up outside off and pushed down to long-on
goes back and works a googly to deep midwicket
full on the pads and squeezed out to deep midwicket
well stopped by Hogg! Tiwary pulls a short one and it really tests Hogg at deep square leg but he times his dive superbly and cuts it off
walks down the pitch straightaway and ends up pushing it to mid-on
inside edge! Trivedi gets him with a slower ball, 107 kph, de Villiers was stuck at the crease and the ball stayed low too, big edge pegs back the middle stump
that was lucky! He made room to shovel that over midwicket and he got an inside edge to his body that beat the stumps and the keeper and down to third man
slower delivery and worked down to deep midwicket
poor delivery, wide and short down the leg side and the keeper fumbles so they pinch an extra run
down the track and he thumps it down to long-off
steers it down to point and a fine start by Hogg
flicked with the spin to deep midwicket, good start by Hogg
the wrong 'un and he goes back and clips it back to the bowler
down the track and Hogg does well to stop a booming drive, with one hand
tossed up and flicked down to square leg
spins in and he whips it down to long-on
short and hit on the groin as De Villers tries to heave it through midwicket, the ball rolls to the short third man region
short of a length, Kohli shuffles slightly and pulls it in a controlled way to short fine leg for a run
slower one, change of pace, Kohli turns it away to midwicket but cant steal a single
an uppish delivery, stays on his toes and punches it to midwicket for another run
shortish delivery, Kohli jumps and flicks it wristily to midwicket for a run
keeps low outside off, De Villiers stays in the crease and drills it to mid-on for a single
width outside off, Kohli waits and slices it past the point fielder, has enough muscle to go to the deep point fence
on the legs, whipped to backward square leg for a well run two
very wristy! that's a typical Kohli shot, flicks it through midwicket for an easy four
Kohli looks to pull that over midwicket but it takes a top edge and goes sailing over behind the keeper but falls safe
slower one outside off, Kohli defends it back to the bowler for no run
pitched on outside off, Kohli gets an inside edge onto his pads, not his stumps this time

Bowled! that's the prize scalp! Gayle doesnt move his feet to a good length delivery outside off, looks to hammer it past cover but gets a thick inside edge onto his stumps, that's timber disturbed, Royals are pumped up!
sprayed down the off side, angling away after it pitched, straight to the keeper

Caught by Owais Shah! Mayank looks to smack it out of the stadium but gets a top edge and high it goes into the dark sky, Shah does well to run to his left and cups it easily in the end, Royals draw first blood here!
back of a length, stays in the crease and pierces the gap between midwicket and mid-on for a four
peach of a delivery, Mcgrath kind of a length, bounces after it pitches, Mayank looks to defend it but misses
shortish delivery, bounces after it pitches, Mayank looks to heave it over square and misses
on the pads, whipped to the man at short fine leg, no run possible
width offered, Mayank opens the face and runs it to third man for a run
on the off, Mayank pulls it to deep midwicket where the fielder chases it, fumbles it but stops it cleanly in the end
dropped by Dravid at short midwicket, Gayle slams an uppish delivery straight to Dravid by doesnt hold onto it, that could be a costly miss
stupendous shot! charges down the track and it launches it into orbit, that's gone as high as moon but clears long-on for a massive six
short on legs, Gayle turns it away in front of square for no run, a gentle one in this crash bang world
goes down on one knee and hoicks it over mid-on, it clears the man at long-on by a whisker for a six, that's come right off the screws
goes down the track and thrashes it over mid-off for a one bounce four, timed that to perfection
full on the middle, Mayank clobbers it over the midwicket fence for half a dozen, that's as flat as it can get
flighted one, Mayank stays in the crease and dabs it to the off side
quicker one, turned off the pads to midwicket, Mayank wanted a single but Gayle says 'no'
flat on the legs, Gayle nudges it to midwicket for a run
zipper of a delivery, Mayank shapes to turn it to the on side but takes a leading edge and goes to the man at point
replay of the shot he just played, outside off and shaping away, looks to drive and misses
on the up seaming away, Mayank looks for the drive and misses, straight to the keeper
good length this time, Mayank pushes it to cover for no run
on good length, makes room and crunches it over covers for a beautiful shot, well timed that one
outside off angling away, Mayank leans and tries to punch it through covers but misses
Gayle does it again, defends it to the off side where Botha picks it up and no run possible
tossed up, shows the full face of the bat and jams it back to Botha
fuller one, pushed to mid-on and the batsmen pinch a single
on the legs, Mayank plays it off his legs to short fine leg
quicker one, goes back and pushes it to cover for no run
starts off with a six! Mayank shuffles and smacks it over fine leg boundary
